How I'd Build Your CS Engine
Customer Success as an Ecosystem
Every company I join starts with the same question: where is the revenue at risk, and where is the growth hidden? My answer is a system, not a list of actions.
First 30 days

Secure & Prioritize

  • Segment the portfolio by ARR tiers
  • Deploy a Health Score based on weighted indicators
  • Meet every Tier 1 account face to face, identify Key Success Factors
  • Build the renewal board, focus on renewals under 120 days
  • Clarify onboarding process around one metric: Time to Value
  • Launch NPS & CSAT workflows: every feedback is an opportunity for action
Days 30-60

Deploy & Correct

  • Activate playbooks tied to Health Score
  • Set up weekly pipeline reviews with Sales, tracking centralized in CRM
  • Standardize QBRs for Tier 1 with an ROI-first agenda
  • Feed the top 3 client frictions to Product every month (Voice of Customer)
  • Create Success Plans for every Tier 1, self-service tutorials for Tier 3-4
  • KPI target: reduce untouched accounts (>40 days)
Days 60-90

Scale & Predict

  • Launch Early Warning System: automated alerts on last touch
  • Automate renewal workflows for Tier 3-4, deploy adoption campaigns
  • Build NRR forecast model: safe renewals, at-risk accounts, probable upsells
  • Churn saves: action plan for Health Score below 60, repositioning on ROI
  • Start internal CS newsletter: NRR, churn saves, adoption, NPS-CSAT
  • KPI target: adoption increase

CS Creations

Choose your battlefield. Churn save, price negotiation, contract renewal. The AI plays your opponent. A coach scores the result.
